system.description: You can connect to restricted data (via an implant, a handheld device, a robotic drone assistant, or the like) that isn't publicly accessible. Ask your GM a question and get a short but accurate answer if you succeed on an Intellect task. The difficulty is routine if it's something anyone could learn via their own method of access, level 3 if the sensitive or secret knowledge is primarily an engineering or scientific topic, and level 5 or higher if your GM decides the information is particularly sensitive or secret, whether scientific in nature or not. Last action.
